title: じぶんでできた！ (Jibun de Dekita!)
description: Six-year-old Sota wants to tie his own shoelaces, button his own shirt, and pour his own juice — but it's hard and he keeps failing. A long, encouraging story about the frustration and ultimate triumph of learning to do things by yourself, told through four separate 'I can do it myself!' moments.
author: オリジナル
